card.name: Inside cholestatic jaundice and similar terms
card.fires_on: The middle of a medical term, mostly the 'und' in 'jaundice' after 'cholestatic' in contraindication lists. It also fires on a few other partway pieces, such as a name or 'Ulceration'.

modes.description: Parts of a name or a long medical term, such as 'Obesity' in an organization name or 'cer' in 'Ulceration'.
